response.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL OR c.state = '' THEN '' ELSE c.state END AS state, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_college) AS share FROM player_college AS pc JOIN college AS c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL OR c.state = '' THEN '' ELSE c.state END ORDER BY state;
